query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN isSuspectedBulk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as suspected,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN isSuspectedBulk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as pct
FROM priceHistory 
WHERE source = 'snkrdunk' AND productType = 'single_card';
